title: Engineering Manager - ML Platform
description: <strong>Who We Are<br><br></strong>Lightricks, an AI-first company, is revolutionizing how visual content is created. With a mission to bridge the gap between imagination and creation, Lightricks is dedicated to bringing cutting-edge technology to the creative and business spaces.<br><br>Our advanced AI photo and video generation models, including our open-source LTXV model, power our apps and platforms including Facetune, Photoleap, Videoleap, and LTX Studio, allowing creators and brands to leverage the latest research breakthroughs, offering endless control over their creative potential. Our influencer marketing platforms, Popular Pays and Content Lab, provide influencers with the ability to scale their content and monetize their work, while offering brands opportunities to expand their reach through tailored creator partnerships.<br><br><strong>What You Will Be Doing<br><br></strong>As the ML Platform Engineering Manager, you'll lead a team of backend engineers building Lightricks' AI infrastructure. Your team bridges research and production, taking cutting-edge ML and generative AI models from our research teams and turning them into scalable systems that power AI features for millions of users.<br><br>The ML Platform team owns the complete AI pipeline - from research prototype to production deployment. You'll build and maintain a high-performance inference platform that serves models at scale, enabling faster research iteration and seamless user experiences across our apps.<br><br>This role requires both technical leadership and people management skills. You'll make key architectural decisions for complex distributed systems while growing and mentoring your engineering team. Success means delivering reliable, scalable AI infrastructure that supports our rapid growth in a fast-paced environment.<br><br><strong>Your Skills And Experience<br><br></strong><ul><li>6+ years of backend systems experience with 1-3 years in engineering management / strong technical leadership experience (tech lead, senior engineer leading platform initiatives)</li><li>Proven track record of building and scaling platform systems, with demonstrated ownership of complex technical projects from design to production</li><li>Solid experience with cloud-based distributed systems, including architecture decisions, deployment strategies, and operational practices</li><li>Strong backend development skills with focus on API design, system scalability, and observability/monitoring</li><li>Experience mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence within fast-growing teams</li><li>Excellent communication skills with ability to collaborate across engineering, product, and other technical teams</li><li>Interest in or exposure to ML model serving, GPU infrastructure, or ML platform tooling - preferred but not required</li><li>Comfortable working in a distributed team environment with flexibility across time zones</li><li>B.Sc. in Computer Science or equivalent technical background<br><br></li></ul><strong>Benefits:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Stock Options.</li><li>Private Medical Insurance (Optical &amp; Dental cover) including your loved ones.</li><li>Life Assurance.</li><li>£3,000/p/a Transport Allowance.</li><li>£750p/a allowance for Wellbeing &amp; Professional Development.</li><li>Free on-site lunches, coffee, breakfast &amp; snacks.</li><li>Pension Contributions (7%).</li><li>Holiday (25 days).</li><li>Seasonal &amp; Anniversary Vouchers.</li><li>Hybrid &amp; Flexible working.</li><li>Cool office space in central London.</li><li>Enhanced Parental Leave.</li><li>Cycle-to-work Scheme.</li><li>Season Ticket Loan.</li><li>Volunteering Opportunities.</li><li>Frequent social activities - away-days, happy hours, team building, yoga, creative workshops.</li></ul>

title: Director of Platform Engineering
description: <p><strong>Director of Platform Engineering | Fintech | London Hybrid</strong></p><p><br></p><p>A global fintech who's technology powers eading e-commerce, payments, and tech brands is looking for a <strong>Director of Platform Engineering</strong> to help drive the next stage of platform and team maturity.</p><p><br></p><p>This role sits at the intersection of <strong>technical depth</strong> and <strong>hands-on leadership</strong>, with a blend of:</p><p>Strong engineering foundations across high-performance platforms, microservices, API-driven development, and distributed systems.</p><p>AND</p><p>Leading and developing teams. The current Platform group is ~25 people. You’ll shape the structure, strengthen collaboration, and support a high-performance culture.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p><ul><li>Evolving cloud-native infrastructure that’s secure, scalable, and resilient.</li><li>Ensuring the Platform Team adds maximum value across the breadth of the business. </li><li>Helping shape an engineering culture focused on clarity, velocity, and collaboration.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p><ul><li>Solid cloud and platform engineering experience (AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC).</li><li>Proven leadership within platform or infrastructure teams.</li><li>A strategic approach to scaling systems in complex environments.</li><li>Experience in high-growth, product-led businesses (fintech helpful but not essential).</li></ul><p></p>

title: Engineering Manager | Convert & Scale
description: <strong>Meet DeepL<br><br></strong>DeepL is a global communications platform powered by Language AI. Since 2017, we’ve been on a mission to break down language barriers. Our human-sounding translations and intelligent writing suggestions are designed with enterprise security in mind. Today, they enable over 100,000 businesses to transform communications, reach new markets, and improve productivity. And, empower millions of individuals worldwide to make sense of the world and express their ideas.<br><br>Our goal is to become the global leader in Language AI, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and make a real-life impact. To achieve this, we need talented individuals like you to join our exciting journey. If you're ready to work with a dynamic team and build your career in the fast-moving AI space, DeepL is your next destination.<br><br><strong>What Sets Us Apart<br><br></strong>What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive. When we share what it's like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This may be because of our products that have helped countless people worldwide or our shared mission to improve communication for individuals and businesses, bringing cultures closer together. What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation and employee well-being. Discover what our teams have to say about life at DeepL on LinkedIn, Instagram and our Blog.<br><br><strong>Meet the team behind this journey<br><br></strong>You will be joining the CAST (Convert and Scale) track, a division of our business that has recently seen increased strategic investment and realignment. You will lead the Identity and Access team, a core platform team responsible for building and scaling the services that power our entire customer ecosystem.<br><br>This team’s domain is central to our business, covering everything from Single Sign-On (SSO) and account management to identity provider (IDP) integration, logins, and session management. As a platform team, your primary customers are other engineering teams at DeepL. You will partner closely with a Technical Product Manager and collaborate with teams like Account and Team Experience and Business Platform to deliver foundational features that enable a secure, scalable, and frictionless experience for all DeepL users.<br><br><strong>Your Responsibilities<br><br></strong><ul><li>People Leadership: Lead, mentor, and grow a talented, UK-based distributed team of 7 senior and intermediate engineers. You will be responsible for their well-being and growth through regular 1:1s, continuous feedback, performance reviews, and dedicated career development coaching.</li><li>Execution &amp; Delivery: Own the team's execution and delivery, establishing a predictable cadence using agile methodologies. You will partner with your Technical Product Manager to define, refine, and deliver the quarterly roadmap, ensuring the team's work aligns with strategic business goals.</li><li>Technical Guidance: Act as the team's technical steward. While this is a 0-10% hands-on coding role, your strong engineering background is crucial. You will guide architectural discussions, review system designs, and uphold high standards for quality, scalability, security, and other non-functional requirements.</li><li>Project &amp; Strategic Ownership: Take ownership of the team's strategic bets. Your first key projects will include delivering our SCIM (System for Cross-domain Identity Management) rollout and device-based authentication, both critical for our enterprise customers.</li><li>Stakeholder Management: Serve as the team's primary representative in planning and technical discussions. You will clearly articulate technical trade-offs and build strong relationships with stakeholders across product, engineering, and the wider business.</li><li>Participation in our on-call rotation: You’ll ensure the reliability and availability of our services by being available to join the team's shared on-call rotation as needed.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Qualities we look for<br><br></strong><strong>Must-Haves<br><br></strong><ul><li>People management experience - ideally 3+ years of direct people management experience, leading a team of 5 - 10 engineers.</li><li>Strong technical foundation - 5+ years of hands-on experience as a Senior or Staff-level engineer, with expertise in C# (or strong, transferable experience in Java).</li><li>Distributed systems design - Proven experience designing, building, and operating scalable, highly available distributed systems.</li><li>Modern tech stack experience - Demonstrable experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS), containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes), and API design (gRPC, REST).</li><li>Database expertise - Hands-on experience with both relational databases (like PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (like Cassandra).</li><li>A "People-First" approach - A deep commitment to the growth and well-being of your team, with proven experience in coaching, mentorship, and performance management.</li><li>Strong execution - A focus on execution and delivery, with a pragmatic approach to balancing technical excellence with the practical need to ship value.</li><li>Excellent problem-solver - The ability to break down complex, ambiguous problems into concrete, actionable steps for your team.</li><li>Clear communicator - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Nice-to-Haves<br><br></strong><ul><li>Domain Knowledge - Experience in the Identity and Access Management (IAM) domain (e.g., SSO, OAuth, SCIM, OIDC).</li><li>Event-Driven systems - Demonstrated experience with event-based processing and messaging systems like Kafka.</li><li>Hiring experience -Proven experience hiring and onboarding software engineers in a distributed team environment.</li><li>DevOps &amp; Scaling -Strong experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure scaling, and cloud migration.<br><br></li></ul><strong>What We Offer<br><br></strong><ul><li>Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.</li><li>Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.</li><li>Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.</li><li>Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.</li><li>Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.</li><li>Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.</li><li>30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.</li><li>Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.<br><br></li></ul>If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!<br><br><strong>We are an equal opportunity employer<br><br></strong>You are welcome at DeepL for who you are—we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

title: Engineering Manager

title: SAP Development Manager
description: <p><strong>SAP S/4HANA Development Lead (12-Month Contract)</strong></p><p> <strong>Global FMCG – London (3 Days Onsite per Week)</strong></p><p>A leading global FMCG organisation is seeking an experienced <strong>SAP S/4HANA Development Lead</strong> to play a pivotal role in a major ERP transformation programme, transitioning from ECC to S/4HANA. This senior leadership position is suited to a technical expert who has recently led or delivered S/4HANA implementations and is committed to building a clean, future-ready digital core.</p><p>The role is accountable for shaping the end-to-end development strategy, leading global development teams, and ensuring high-quality delivery of custom applications, extensions, and integrations across a complex, multinational FMCG landscape. This programme will form the foundation of global operations for many years ahead, offering a significant opportunity to influence architecture and drive modernisation.</p><p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p><p><strong>Leadership &amp; Strategy</strong></p><ul><li>Serve as the Development Lead for the global S/4HANA transformation, owning the application development workstream.</li><li>Translate the programme roadmap into a clear development and delivery strategy aligned with business and architectural requirements.</li><li>Define and enforce clean core principles, custom code strategy, and governance frameworks for development, testing, and transport management.</li><li>Work closely with Enterprise Architecture, Functional, and Integration teams to maximise standardisation, reuse, and innovation.</li></ul><p><strong>Technical Delivery</strong></p><ul><li>Oversee all custom development across the S/4HANA ecosystem, including in-app and side-by-side extensions.</li><li>Manage interfaces, APIs, and integrations using SAP BTP, CPI, and related tools.</li><li>Lead SAP Fiori/UI5 application development and modern UX enablement.</li><li>Drive custom code remediation and optimisation from ECC to S/4HANA, including CDS views, ABAP on HANA, and ABAP Cloud.</li><li>Lead and manage a global development factory (internal and offshore teams) to ensure timely and high-quality delivery.</li><li>Apply Agile and DevOps practices, enabling iterative development, automated testing, and continuous deployment.</li></ul><p><strong>Governance, Compliance &amp; Quality</strong></p><ul><li>Ensure all development complies with GxP, SOX, and GDPR requirements within a regulated FMCG environment.</li><li>Establish coding standards, review processes, and automated testing frameworks (e.g., ABAP Unit, ATC).</li><li>Partner with QA and Validation teams to ensure deliverables meet regulatory and audit standards.</li><li>Maintain full documentation and traceability across the SDLC.</li></ul><p><strong>Stakeholder Management</strong></p><ul><li>Act as the primary development point of contact within the S/4HANA programme.</li><li>Collaborate with business process owners, functional teams, and integration partners to translate requirements into robust technical designs.</li><li>Communicate risks, issues, progress, and dependencies to programme leadership and stakeholders.</li><li>Mentor global development teams, fostering capability growth and collaboration.</li></ul><p><strong>Continuous Improvement</strong></p><ul><li>Champion modernisation through SAP BTP, Fiori, automation, and best-practice engineering techniques.</li><li>Drive system performance tuning and post-go-live optimisation.</li><li>Support knowledge sharing and continuous improvement across SAP development teams.</li></ul><p><strong>Qualifications &amp; Experience</strong></p><p><strong>Essential</strong></p><ul><li>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.</li><li>10+ years of SAP technical experience, including recent leadership of S/4HANA implementation workstreams.</li><li>Expertise in:</li><li>ABAP on HANA, CDS, AMDP, OData</li><li>SAP Fiori/UI5 development and extensibility</li><li>SAP BTP, CPI, and modern integration patterns</li><li>Custom code remediation and optimisation for ECC to S/4HANA transformation</li><li>Strong understanding of clean core strategy and global development leadership.</li><li>Experience working in regulated industries such as FMCG, food, pharma, or consumer health.</li><li>Strong knowledge of SAP development tools (Eclipse), SAP Solution Manager or Cloud ALM, transport and release management, and DevOps toolchains.</li></ul><p><strong>Desirable</strong></p><ul><li>SAP certifications in ABAP for S/4HANA, SAP BTP, or Fiori.</li><li>Experience with SAP Activate and Agile methodologies.</li><li>Familiarity with MES, PLM, LIMS, and external manufacturing system integrations.</li><li>Exposure to data migration tools such as LTMC or BODS.</li><li>Experience in multi-country, multi-entity environments with complex supply chains.</li><li>Awareness of emerging AI and automation capabilities in SAP development.</li></ul><p><strong>Key Competencies</strong></p><ul><li>Strategic and hands-on leadership within global transformation programmes.</li><li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.</li><li>Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.</li><li>Confidence operating within a matrixed, multinational environment.</li><li>Commitment to quality, compliance, and business value delivery.</li></ul><p><strong>Why This Opportunity Stands Out</strong></p><p>This is a rare chance to contribute to a major global FMCG S/4HANA transformation that will define operational capabilities for the next decade. The role offers exposure to leading-edge SAP technologies, complex global landscapes, and the opportunity to make a significant long-term impact.</p>

title: Senior Engineering Manager | UK

That's the future we're creating.<br><br>Cleo is a rare success story: a profitable, fast-growing unicorn with over $200 million in ARR and growing over 2x year-over-year. We have an exceptionally high bar for talent, seeking individuals who are not only at the top of their field but also embody our culture of collaboration and positive impact.<br><br>If you’re driven by complex challenges that push your expertise, the chance to shape something truly transformative, and the potential to share in Cleo’s success as we scale, while growing alongside a company that’s scaling fast, this might be your perfect fit.<br><br>Follow us on LinkedIn to keep up to date with new product features and insights from the team.<br><br>The Role<br><br>Cleo is radically different from the norm and we’re looking for a senior engineering manager to guide and further develop our engineers across our cross functional product squads. You will be responsible for the teams and pillar technical delivery as they create exceptional products for our customers, as well as the wellbeing and development of your reports.<br><br>You’ll be responsible for all people management of multiple squads and engineers within a pillar. This means hiring the right spread of TL’s, engineers (juniors, seniors and leads), and then coaching and developing them to deliver on the roadmap. You’ll build out the headcount plan and will be responsible for all hiring and team development within your area to support our growth.<br><br>You’ll be accountable for all engineering needs for multiple squads working closely with your counterparts in product, data and experience to build high-performing cross-functional teams so that they deliver impact on our company mission in the most effective way possible. We’ll also be looking to you to develop some of our current squad-focused Leads into more senior positions to support you in the future.<br><br>You’ll be responsible for all technical leadership; this means actively seeking out opportunities to improve or optimise processes, participating in design sessions, reviewing technical proposals and developing the technical roadmap for your area.<br><br>Want to hear directly from the team? Check out this blog post from a few of our engineering managers. <br><br><strong>About You<br><br></strong>We’re looking for a<strong> Senior Engineering Manager</strong> that has exceptional people leadership skills, with an understanding of building a culture of technical excellence. On top of this:<br><br><ul><li>You are the kind of manager who is people first, technology second. We build environments to support our engineers to be the most impactful engineers possible. We have to strike the right balance between short term gains and longer term sustainability, and our engineering principles reflect this.</li><li>You have previously been a hands-on software developer, but these days get your kicks from software architecture and organisation design, debugging people and processes, and delivering through others.</li><li>You are a great communicator. We are a tight-knit engineering management team, who support one another to be the best leaders possible. You need to be comfortable challenging and supporting us. </li><li>You are comfortable with change and can adapt to constantly changing circumstances. We’re growing the team, and we want you to grow with us on that journey. </li><li>You practise a learning and growth mindset. We move quickly and experiment lots and we need you to help people learn and grow from their experiences. <br><br></li></ul>Our Tech Stack<br><br>Cleo is built as a Ruby on Rails monolith with a single React Native app frontend, utilising TypeScript. We also leverage Python for machine learning services and PostgreSQL for our database, all hosted on AWS. Our CI/CD pipeline is fully automated, with production deployments happening on every merge via Heroku. Our backend engineers deploy multiple times a week, and we release our frontend app to Google and Apple for review at least once a week.<br><br>While we take a pragmatic approach, we place a strong emphasis on quality. Our code is peer-reviewed, and we maintain automated testing using Minitest and CircleCI. We're also actively working towards a more modular architecture, focusing on separating concerns to achieve all the benefits of microservices within a monolith, while progressively refactoring our code as we build new features. Everyone in the engineering team contributes to driving our technical strategy, voices &amp; ideas from all levels are valued: we are all owners at Cleo.<br><br>What do you get for all your hard work?<br><br><ul><li>A competitive compensation package (base + equity) with bi-annual reviews, aligned to our quarterly OKR planning cycles. You can view our public progression framework and salary bandings here: https://cleo-ai.progressionapp.com/ </li><li>Work at one of the fastest-growing tech startups, backed by top VC firms, Balderton &amp; EQT Ventures</li><li>A clear progression plan. We want you to keep growing. That means trying new things, leading others, challenging the status quo and owning your impact. Always with our complete support. </li><li>Flexibility. We can’t fight for the world’s financial health if we’re not healthy ourselves. We work with everyone to make sure they have the balance they need to do their best work</li><li>Work where you work best. We’re a globally distributed team. Our Poland team works fully remotely, but we host virtual socials and an annual company offsite somewhere in Europe with all expenses paid.</li><li>Other benefits;</li><li>Company-wide performance reviews every 6 months </li><li>Generous pay increases for high-performing team members</li><li>Equity top-ups for team members getting promoted</li><li>25 days annual leave a year + public holidays (+ an additional day for every year you spend at Cleo, up to 30 days)</li><li>Private medical insurance via Vitality, dental cover, and life assurance</li><li>1 month paid sabbatical after 4 years at Cleo</li><li>Regular socials and activities, online and in-person</li><li>We'll pay for your OpenAI subscription</li><li>Online mental health support via Spill</li><li>Enhanced parental leave</li><li>Workplace Nursery Scheme </li><li>And many more!<br><br></li></ul><em>We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.<br><br></em><em>If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.<br><br></em><strong>UK App access:</strong> The Cleo app is no longer downloadable in the UK. If you’re an existing user, you’ll still have access to the app. But some features won’t be available. Why? 99% of our users are based in the US – where financial health is often overlooked. We’ve decided to shift our focus to where we can provide the most value and make the greatest impact for users who need it most. Then we’ll be able to apply what we learn to better support our UK users in the future.<br><br>By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact.
